about.title: About KAUP
about.body: KAUP is an online store for phone and PC accessories. Products are supplied and shipped by our fulfilment partner, mostly from warehouses in China. The price you see includes the product and our margin; delivery is charged separately and shown before you pay.

contact.title: Contact us
contact.body: Questions about an order, a product or a delivery? Write to us and include your order number (for example KP-AB12CD) so we can help faster.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: Most products ship directly from our partner warehouses in China. Delivery estimates are shown before you pay.
faq.q2: Which payment methods do you accept?
faq.a2: Visa, Mastercard and UnionPay credit and debit cards.
faq.q3: How can I track my order?
faq.a3: Open Profile → My orders. You'll also receive a notification whenever your order status changes.
faq.a4: Some countries charge import duty on parcels above a certain value. Any duties are set by your local customs office.
faq.a5: If your item arrives damaged, faulty or isn't what you ordered, contact us with your order number and photos and we'll work out a solution with you.

shipping.title: Shipping information
shipping.body: Choose Standard, Express or Priority at checkout. The exact price and estimated delivery window for your country are shown before you pay. Delivery dates are estimates and can vary with customs and local carriers.

returns.title: Returns & refunds
returns.body: If your item arrives damaged, faulty or isn't what you ordered, contact us with your order number and photos. We'll review it and arrange a replacement or a refund to your original card where appropriate.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.body: We collect only what's needed to process your orders: your name, email, phone, delivery address and order history. Card details are handled by our payment processor and never stored on our servers. We don't sell your data. You can update your profile or request deletion at any time by contacting us.

terms.title: Terms of service
terms.body: By using KAUP you agree to provide accurate information and to use the store lawfully. Prices are in US dollars and may change. An order is accepted once payment is confirmed. Delivery dates are estimates. Our liability is limited to the amount you paid for the product.
